text:
Alex Kim: Heads-up: predictive capacity alert on hosted-usw2 GPU pool. Forecast model shows a sustained p95 queueing increase starting ~2026-03-19T12:00Z (next 6h window). Expected request rate ~2.6x baseline due to new onboarding job from customer PeakFlow. Link: https://dash.redwood.internal/gpu/usw2/forecast?job=peakflow :rotating_light:

Maria Gonzales: I can see the same spike on the forecast curve. 95th latency expected to hit ~420ms if admission unchanged. Current headroom ~= 18% across the pool.

Jon Patel: What does the admission control schedule look like? can we temporarily relax rate limits for Dedicated customers and bump burst pool?

Sophie Li: @Jon we can route ~20% of hosted traffic to euw1/usw3 as overflow, but that increases egress & SLO risk. Need approval from capacity to enable cross-region overspill.

ops-bot: alert: hosted-usw2 forecasted-admission-pressure at 2026-03-19T12:00Z. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/gpu-overflow

Alex Kim: Quick triage checklist: 1) confirm PeakFlow onboarding start time, 2) enable ephemeral burst (if allowed), 3) open routing rule for overflow to usw3, 4) update dashboards & notify SRE pager. I'll ping PeakFlow.

Maria Gonzales: PeakFlow PM confirmed start at 12:05Z. They expect short-lived heavy batch imports (approx 90 minutes). They agreed to throttle if needed.

Jon Patel: Proposed immediate mitigations:
- enable burst-reserve: 2 nodes from reserved pool (config below)
- lower admission p95 target temporarily to 600ms
- enable cache-prefixing for medium-latency requests

Config snippet:
```
admission:
  target_p95_ms: 600
  burst_reserve_nodes: 2
  overflow_regions: ["usw3", "euw1"]
```

Sophie Li: I'll start the overflow routing change but need a quick TTL for rollback. Suggest 30m window with auto-rollback if p95 < 350ms for two consecutive 5m windows.

Alex Kim: @Sophie set TTL 30m auto-rollback true. @ops-bot please annotate dashboards and create short-lived alert suppression for noise:tag=peakflow-onboard

ops-bot: action logged. Suppression ID s-20260319-01 applied. Reminder: do not suppress real critical alerts.

Jon Patel: Cost note: routing 20% to usw3 will add ~$1.2k/hr in egress & multi-region overhead for the window. Noted by finance.

Priya Rao: (finance) Aware of the cost; PeakFlow has agreed to cover onboarding overage. Please tag the invoice with project:peakflow-onboard.

Alex Kim: Oncall assignment: @Jon you handle burst-reserve & admission tweak; @Sophie handle overflow routing; @Maria monitor p95 & KV cache hit; I'll coordinate comms with PeakFlow and product.

Jon Patel: started: bumping reserved nodes now -> `./infractl pool add-reserved --pool hosted-usw2 --count 2`

Maria Gonzales: p95 trending: 380ms -> 410ms after initial routing changes. Headroom down to 6%. KV cache hit improved by +4% after prefixing.

Sophie Li: overflow rule active to usw3. Will monitor egress. Will rollback automatically at 12:35Z unless condition persists.

Alex Kim: Nice work. Keep this thread for play-by-play. If things cross threshold (p95 > 700ms or queue depth > 3k) escalate to SRE pager immediately.

Jon Patel: update: reserved nodes online, admission updated. Running soak.

Maria Gonzales: 12:20Z update: p95 peaked 445ms, queue depth peaked 1.8k, currently stable and trending down. Suppression still active.

Sophie Li: auto-rollback triggered at 12:35Z — overflow disabled, egress stopped. p95 now 320ms. Closing loop.

Alex Kim: Postmortem action items: (1) add predictive forecast to oncall runbook, (2) improve auto-burst to be policy-driven, (3) surface cost impact pre-approval UI. Assign to roadmap. :white_check_mark:
